projects.title: Excel Sales Performance Dashboard
projects.description: An interactive Excel dashboard built on a sales dataset of 2,000 order records. It summarises revenue and order activity by time period, region, product category, sales channel and product, with slicers and date timelines for filtering.
highlights: KPI cards for total revenue, total orders, quantity sold and average order value
Slicers for region, product category, customer type and sales channel, plus date timelines
Charts for revenue by month, region, product category and sales channel, and a top-5 products view
projects.imageAlt: Screenshot of the Sales Performance Dashboard in Excel showing KPI cards, slicers and revenue charts
